sentences.text: Lusitanisuchus belongs to the class Reptilia and the parent group Mesoeucrocodylia.
A reexamination of fossils from the Guimarota Formation proved it was a crocodylomorph rather than a lizard.
The only species, Lusitanisuchus mitracostatus, was named in 2004 after previously being described as Lisboasaurus in 1970.
Lusitanisuchus coexisted with many dinosaurs in the Lusitanian Basin during the Late Jurassic and Early Cretaceous.
The genus lived from 152.21 to 149.2 million years ago during the Kimmeridgian stage.
Teeth found at Porto Dinheiro, Lourinhã in Berriasian strata extend the known temporal range of the taxon by about 15 million years.
